row:
Total number of parking spaces required vs. provided,
broken down by land use.

Parking geometry (stall dimensions, drive aisle widths,
turning radii).

Parking surface material, striping, and pavement
markings.

Location and type of parking facilities (structured,
surface, or shared).

Bicycle and micromobility parking (short- and long-
term).

Loading and service zones (dimensions, access routes,
clearances).

Clearly labeled/numbered on-street parking space
addition/reduction
Internal pedestrian circulation routes and crossings.

Connection points to existing sidewalks, trails, and bike
lanes.

Transit stop locations and accommodations (shelters,
benches).

Bicycle/pedestrian connectivity to adjacent
developments and public rights-of-way.

Identification of high-stress bicycle/pedestrian conflict
points and mitigation measures.

Drop-off/pick-up areas for rideshare, micromobility,
and paratransit.

Summary of proposed TDM strategies (transit passes,
shuttle, unbundled parking, mobility contribution).
